The '''dune bantha''' was a subspecies of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] which originated on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was rangier, less furry, and more slender than the common [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] used by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] as mounts. The dune bantha lived in the equatorial regions of Tatooine and survived with relatively little water and very high temperatures.<ref name="Wildlife" />
